illustrations.prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual, a single original editorial illustration for the right or left half of a widescreen AEC presentation. Sophisticated tactile architectural papercraft, photographed three-quarter view with sculpted layers of sharply cut matte paper and card, restrained natural material texture, petrol green, light sage, warm ivory and small terracotta accents. Calm, credible, uncluttered. Landscape 3:2 with all elements fully visible and clean safety space on all sides. True transparent PNG alpha outside the subjects, including open spaces between them. Fully defined crisp silhouettes, no fading, feathering, halo, vignette, gradients at edges, backdrop, bounding frame, outer outline, or ground shadow. No letters, numbers, labels, watermarks or marks that resemble text. Picture only.
An isolated editorial scene of one project engineer at a compact desk, with a low-slung laptop and three distinctly colored project document folders open within easy reach. The three folders have different tab shapes and contain a modest number of technical drawing sheets. Show the person working thoughtfully with two sheets at once, relatable office wear. The complete small desk, seated figure and folders form one clear silhouette. The idea is one engineer working across several client systems. No background, no building exterior, no office wall, no decorative pedestal.
illustrations.edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the paper-craft engineer working at a desk with three differently colored project folders and an open laptop. Preserve the scene, the engineering drawings, the warm paper palette and the true transparent cutout style. Reframe this exact composition to a full, pulled-back view with the desk and both complete desk supports fully visible. Zoom out enough to leave clear empty space between every object and all four image edges. The lowest desk and chair points must sit well above the image bottom, never be clipped, and have at least 12% transparent canvas underneath. All open space must be true PNG alpha. Crisp natural edges, no shadow on the background, no fade, no rectangular backdrop or frame. No text. Landscape 3:2.
